notes.title: Update is live
notes.notes:
Pushed an update to Steam:

- added leaderboard for each level
- tweaked mouse hiding logic to hide the mouse more appropriately

Check it out, please leave some feedback. Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Now Available on Early Access
notes.notes:
Rescue Love Revenge is available for purchase on Steam Early Access and a free demo is also available. New chapters are coming soon plus a level editor integrated with Steam Workshop as well as multiplayer from local to online, among other additions incoming. Launch week has a 20% discount, knocking the price all the way down to $3.99! You say free 99?! No, but the demo's free!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/397730/

[url=https://www.facebook.com/RescueLoveRevenge/]RLR[/url] was developed by [url=https://www.facebook.com/Hatchlight/]Hatchlight[/url] and is published by [url=https://www.facebook.com/Rich-Pine-130502297129931/]Rich Pine[/url].
